A 91 year old patient, with a history of falls and who had attended A&E due to a fall was discharged home at 04:17 hours in the early morning to his elderly wife. There was no formal assessment as to his abilities, the home environment or his wife's abilities to look after him. No consideration was given to post discharge planning or assessment of needs such as district nurse or social care follow up. The Department, at that time, did not have in place any formal policy or procedure for risk
